meta.title: ZibonSathi - Islamic Matrimony Platform
meta.description: A safe Islamic marriage matchmaking platform

footer.tagline: ZibonSathi is a trusted Islamic matrimony platform where practising brides and grooms can find a suitable life partner through biodatas.
footer.stayConnected: Stay connected with us for the latest updates

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: The page you are looking for has been moved or does not exist.

home.heroSubtitle: Search verified Islamic biodatas from your own area that match your preferences, completely free.
home.ctaBody: Create your biodata in just a few minutes and reach thousands of practising families.
home.howSubtitle: Find your life partner in four simple steps
home.step1Body: Open a free account and easily create your biodata.
home.step2Body: Find suitable biodatas by age, address, education and marital status.
home.step3Body: If you like someone, send a connection request and contact their guardian.
home.step4Body: Make inquiries as a family and complete the marriage according to the Sunnah.
home.ayahTranslation: “And among His signs is that He created for you mates from among yourselves, that you may find tranquillity in them”
home.hadithText: When a servant marries, he has completed half of his religion; so let him fear Allah regarding the other half.
